original_test_intent: Stress every applicable ConnectX-7 and BlueField-3 InfiniBand port with approved read/write traffic for one hour and verify SPEC bandwidth plus error-free platform/fabric health.
original_method: Do not execute until adapter/serial/BDF/IB-device/port/GUID/GID/peer map, read/write tool/profile and numeric per-port SPEC are approved; then validate fabric state, run finite synchronized traffic for one hour on each required direction/path, collect throughput/latency/counters/events, abort on limits and restore fabric/CPU affinity.
manual_activity: After resolution, operator/peer owner configures fabric, supervises saturation and recovery.
required_inputs: Peer endpoints/IP/GID/link rate/width and fabric manager
OFED/perftest versions and exact read/write commands
agent_execution_scope: May validate approved topology and analyze evidence
Must not infer topology/SPEC or saturate production fabric

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Signed fabric matrix binds every port/direction to peer, command and threshold with counter deltas.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identities, exact read/write semantics, numeric oracle, finite roles and recovery.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Bandwidth depends on negotiated rate, width, message size and CPU/NUMA placement; unspecified SPEC is not evaluable.

review_improvement: Prevents unresolved port variables and unspecified SPEC from masquerading as all-port IB coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: IB throughput is path- and role-specific. Without stable GUID/GID/peer mapping and numeric per-path baseline, sequential commands can test the wrong port and no result can be judged against the stated SPEC.
